facts.fact: Zero Draft 2 of the National Data Governance Policy and Implementation Strategy, drafted as a Council of Ministers Resolution with number and approval date left blank, has an open data section requiring all ministries, agencies and parastatals to proactively release non-sensitive datasets; the document has no face date, so its published date (2025-11, an upload-folder proxy) is used.
